comments.headline: Zoning impervious cover and FAR documentation status unclear
comments.summary: Cover sheet does not clearly document the project's compliance with zoning and watershed impervious cover requirements. Floor Area Ratio (FAR) calculations are absent, and redevelopment exception election status is undocumented. Applicability of both requirements must be verified.
comments.crossDep: Zoning Department — clarification needed on whether FAR limits apply to MF-2 zoning district and whether redevelopment exception is being elected for watershed compliance.
comments.attn: Both findings marked 'not-verifiable.' FAR applicability for MF-2 zoning and redevelopment exception election status must be confirmed. LDC provisions for the zoning district must be reviewed to determine if FAR calculations are required. Existing impervious cover at 65% cap (Urban watershed) with proposed IC ~59.5–60% suggests possible redevelopment exception use, but no explicit election statement appears in accessible plan documents.
